title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.326 - Added `mcpServersDelivery: 'initialize'`: sends `mcpServers` in the initialize request instead of on Claude Code's command line; needs the bundled Claude Code or newer - Added `getSessionInfo()` to the `/core` entry - Added `message_uuid` to `cancel_async_message` responses, naming the dropped message - Added a warning on stderr and as a `system/informational` message when a tool list has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule - Added a `system/informational` warning, tagged `managed_mcp_arrived`, when an administrator's `managed-mcp.json` arrives during a session and your own MCP servers stop loading - Fixed a tool call in a running turn reconnecting to an MCP server just removed with `setMcpServers()`, or reporting that it needs authentication; the call is now refused - Fixed `resumeSessionAt` failing on an empty reply, and a resumed session losing recent turns after a crash when the previous turn ended with one - Fixed a tool result from an SDK MCP server being lost, or delivered to another call, when a long call overlapped a reconnect of the SDK MCP servers
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
